 tool set

 and healthy equipment as safety helmet,

Clean

Inspect

 guide of the contactor

Inspect the

 socket by video cleaner

Check the 
 mechanism of the circuit breaker, clean it with gas and grease it, check its

Technical Procedure
Introduction
This documents out lines the check list 
 I1, which must be performed every four months as indicated by M4 at the 
 titled block.
The first draft was initiated by eng. Al-Sayed 
Abdel Monem Al-Geddawy, and tested on El harbea feeder no. 4 at Sheraton 
Almatar Substation at 06 March 2002 Cairo Zone.
Safety Precautions
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Ensure that the CB is out of service and out of its place.
Switch off DC source
Environmental Precautions
Before start cleaning, wear 
breathing mask to protect lung tissues from dust particles and chemical solvent 
which, if exist, expose lungs to danger
Don't throw grease 
on ground, collect it and send to central labs to recycle it.
Don't burn clothes used in cleaning, collect it and send to dumb
Tools and Equipment
Suitable 
 tool set
Pieces of

Grease and 
 cleaning liquid (like gasoline)
Safety
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, ... 
 etc
Work to be Carried Out
Clean 
 porcelain insulators of the circuit breaker from dust, dirties, deposits 
 ....etc then check these insulators to be free of cracking and scratching
Check 
 contacts to be in good condition, also check the spring pressing the contact 
 to get good contact
Clean the 
 contacts with gas to remove the old grease and then put new grease
Inspect 
 contact arms and check it to be in good condition and attached well to breaker 
 body and to be exactly horizontal
Check the 
 guide of the contactor
Inspect the 
 vacuum capsules as explained in the Arabic document
Clean the 
 socket by video cleaner
Check the 
 mechanism of the circuit breaker, clean it with gas and grease it, check its 
 parts for easy move
Retighten 
 bolts and screws
Switch on 
 the circuit breaker and off in test position mechanically and electrically
